**Eneba Intern Assignment 2027** 

You have to complete this homework assignment within 7 days after getting the assignment. Please reply to the registration email with your results as described below. 

**Requirements of the assignment** 

• AI and agentic coding is strongly encouraged. Ask your agent to save a log of your conversations (full) which are required to submit. In case you use a non-agentic approach, please provide a link to the conversation. 

• We want to understand how you use AI. 

• You must be able to explain your code. 

• Shortcuts are allowed, specs are intentionally vague and open for interpretation \- you decide the scope and you will have to justify it. 

• Please implement a marketplace web application in Eneba's style that matches eneba.com website, with the following parts: 

o **Store**: A catalog where visitors can browse every product in the marketplace. They can narrow the list with filters (for example platform, region or price), change the order, and search by name. 

o **Homepage**: The landing page is assembled from several different blocks, such as a banner, best sellers or deals. Each block gets its content from its own backend service or database, so the frontend only displays what it receives and nothing is hardcoded there. 

o **Search**: Visitors can search for products by name from anywhere in the app and see the matching results. Search should cope with typos and partial names where it can. o **Product page**: The page for a single product, showing its details and the offers from several sellers, so a buyer can compare and choose. 

o **Checkout**: A buyer can put products in a cart, pay, and receive the digital key they bought. Payment can be simulated or use a payment provider’s test mode. No real money is involved. 

o **Authentication**: Visitors can create an account and sign in. Some parts of the app, such as checkout and order history, are only for signed-in users. 

o **Eneba styling**: The app should look and feel like Eneba. Colors, typography, spacing and components follow the design reference.

![][image1]  
• Technical requirements: 

o React for frontend (TypeScript preferred) 

o Backend in PHP (or Go), REST or GraphQL 

o Any database, decide on the data you need yourself 

o Architecture, data model and scope are yours to decide. A few features done extensively beat many fitting minimal requirements 

• Deliverables (no evaluation without the following): 

o Github link(s) to the project 

o Public URL where the app is deployed on a free-tier service (for example Render or Vercel) 

o Agent chat history (full, both prompts and responses) in a md file or a link to AI chat
